title: Légal's Mate
setup: Black has just eaten your queen on d1, and its king stands on e7 with three white pieces around it.
hint: The queen is already gone, so count the black king's squares instead and find the one nobody covers yet.
explanation:
## The Idea

This is Légal's Mate. The bishop on f7 owns e6 and e8, the knight on e5 owns d7, and {{Nd5#}} checks while covering f6. Black's own queen, bishop and pawn block the rest. Three minor pieces can be worth more than a queen.
